section.heading: What is AI?
section.paragraph: Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines. These systems are designed to think, learn, and make decisions like humans.

bulletPoints.point: Transforms how we work, interact, and solve problems.
Enhances efficiency and decision-making across industries.
Drives innovation in fields like healthcare, finance, education, and beyond.
Retail: Customer personalization, supply chain optimization.
